verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own rules capability: a first-party 'Filters & Rules' help article, plus community reports of 'flexible Sieve filters' that users set up to handle incoming mail. The first-party evidence is only an article title, though, and one user reports that filters don't apply to existing emails, so the range of triggers and actions is unproven. Missing for 10: documented trigger types and action set beyond incoming-mail filtering, first-party detail on rule conditions and actions, triggers on events other than mail arrival, and retroactive application to existing mail.
